snippet.title: No Murders in Grimwick – Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Welcome to Grimwick, where the annual harvest festival has been interrupted by a very inconvenient murder.

No Murders in Grimwick is a hand-drawn point-and-click mystery where you play as an out-of-town journalist sent to cover a small-town harvest festival. Question the townsfolk, follow clues, use items, and uncover what really happened — all while the town insists there are absolutely no murders in Grimwick.

Wishlist No Murders in Grimwick on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5198670/No_Murders_in_Grimwick/

Planned release: October 2026

Developed by Bee & Boo Games

#indiegame #pointandclick #mysterygame
